subject.title: feat(web): redesign the clickclack.chat product website

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full clickclack.chat redesign and root-route code-splitting direction as the core product website, or narrow the PR to only the technical fixes?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and visually proven, but a public product website redesign is a brand/product direction choice that automation should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Adopt after cleanup
options.body: Approve the redesign direction, remove the CHANGELOG.md entry, and continue normal merge review on the current patch.

options.title: Narrow to technical fixes
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that keeps code-splitting, CSS isolation, self-host link labeling, and mono ligature fixes without replacing the whole landing page.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Keep or close the branch until maintainers have a sponsored website direction for clickclack.chat.

recommendation.title: Adopt after cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the redesign direction, remove the CHANGELOG.md entry, and continue normal merge review on the current patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced the current product-site surface and has the strongest product-site history signal in this repository.
